title: Functions
text:
A function maps every element of a set to exactly one element of another set.
Let
\[
f:A\to B.
\]
We say that \(f\) is injective if
\[
f(a_1)=f(a_2)
\implies
a_1=a_2.
\]


Consider
\[
f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}
\]
defined by
\[
f(x)=2x+1.
\]
Suppose
\[
f(a)=f(b).
\]
Then
\[
2a+1=2b+1,
\]
so
\[
a=b.
\]
Therefore \(f\) is injective.
